title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 improper authorization allowed viewing build process details via…
description: An improper authorization vulnerability in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7 allows users with limited privileges to view build process details via agent stacktraces. This issue could expose sensitive build information to unauthorized users.
